_decoded.interpretation: A near-dormant fork of an already-deprecated HashiCorp Packer provisioner plugin. No Paradox-authored functional commits (only automated dependency bumps), no Go module proxy indexing (pkg.go.dev has never resolved a `go get` for it), and the sole GitHub release has no attached binary. Best read as a legacy VM/Salt-based provisioning artifact from an earlier infra era, kept alive only by Dependabot -- consistent with the recon-plan's 'legacy on-prem/VM lineage' hypothesis, but the evidence here is closer to ABANDONED than actively used.
